programme: NOTCH1, ZBTB7A, TRIM22, FOSL2 and NFKBIZ converge on the canonical NF-κB node (their target sets include NFKB1, NFKB2, NFKBIA and RELA) to run a cytokine-storm/myeloid-activation programme: NFKBIZ (an atypical IκB) licenses IL6/TNF/IFNG/CCL2/IL17A transcription, FOSL2 is the AP-1 partner that fixes myeloid and fibrotic output (IL6, IL2, IL5, IL11, TGFB1/3, MMP13, NOS2), TRIM22 both restricts SARS-CoV-2 replication directly (degrading NSP8) and feeds back on the same NF-κB nodes, while NOTCH1 and ZBTB7A sit further upstream, gating NFKB1/NFKB2/NFKBIA/RELA and the CDKN1A/BCL2/RB1 survival axis that shapes how strongly a cell can execute that output.
role_in_a: In COVID-19 this is the hyperinflammatory/cytokine-storm and myeloid-dysfunction axis of severe disease: NFKBIZ and TRIM22 variants track with critical outcome and vaccine response, TRIM22 also acts as a direct antiviral restriction factor against SARS-CoV-2, and FOSL2 marks the immature myeloid shift seen in critically ill patients.
role_in_b: Not documented in the record for Pheochromocytoma_and_Paraganglioma (Open Targets shows no association for any of the five factors, and no PMID here places any of them in PPGL). If active, the expected role would be the tumor/stress-associated inflammatory response that accompanies catecholamine excess — e.g. during a secretory crisis — rather than a driver of tumorigenesis itself.
shared_axis: Both diseases can produce an acute catecholamine/cytokine surge with overlapping clinical presentation (hypertensive crisis, tachycardia, multiorgan stress) — severe COVID-19 cytokine storm and pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma crisis are recognised look-alikes in acute-care settings — so an NF-κB/AP-1-driven inflammatory module could plausibly be shared as the acute-phase output in both, but this is a reasoned parallel, not something the retrieved record demonstrates for PPGL.
reasoning: The five factors form a nameable, internally consistent NF-κB/AP-1 module and the record places most of them (via PMID or Open Targets percentile) in COVID-19, satisfying the disease-A side. But nothing in the record — no PMID, no Open Targets score — places any of them in PPGL, so the cross-disease link rests entirely on the clinical-mimicry reasoning above rather than on retrieved evidence; that keeps it short of 'supported' and short of 'strong'.
support: PMID 39384777 — NFKBIZ variants and COVID-19 vaccine seroconversion/breakthrough outcomes (places NFKBIZ in COVID-19); PMID 35777990 — NFKB1/NFKBIA/NFKBIZ variants and critical COVID-19 outcome (places NFKBIZ in COVID-19); PMID 38275298 — TRIM22 restricts SARS-CoV-2 replication via NSP8 degradation (places TRIM22 in COVID-19 mechanistically); PMID 36621405 — TRIM5α/TRIM22 expression and COVID-19 clinical course (places TRIM22 in COVID-19); PMID 36028902 — TRIM22 SNPs and COVID-19 (places TRIM22 in COVID-19); PMID 33248817 — immature myeloid profile including FOSL2 in critically ill COVID-19 (places FOSL2 in COVID-19). No PMID here supports NOTCH1 or ZBTB7A specifically in COVID-19 (their papers were off-topic per the reader's notes), and none support any of the five factors in Pheochromocytoma_and_Paraganglioma.
how_to_falsify: Profile NFKBIZ, FOSL2 and TRIM22 expression (and nuclear RELA localisation) in PPGL tumor tissue or plasma sampled during a catecholamine/secretory crisis versus a non-crisis resection, and compare the induction pattern to matched severe/critical COVID-19 cytokine-storm samples; if PPGL crisis tissue does not show concordant activation of this NF-κB/AP-1 node, the shared-axis claim is disproven and the concordance across patient groups is better explained by a generic stress-response signature than by this specific module.
caveats: Tissue pairing is adrenal (PPGL) versus blood (COVID-19) — anatomically unrelated, linked here only through a systemic acute-inflammation analogy. 40 patient-group comparisons come from only 4 independent cohort pairs, so the concordance count likely contains correlated, non-independent replicates rather than 40 truly separate confirmations. Every one of the twelve listed factors has zero Open Targets association and (for most) zero retrieved literature for PPGL specifically — this account cannot claim anything established for disease B, only extrapolation. STAT1, STAT3, GFI1 and CEBPD were removed as tissue-generic, which is why the more obvious interferon-response story is unavailable here and the account had to be built from the NF-κB/AP-1 side instead; TCF3, BMAL2, ZNF331, FOXL2, FOXD1, SIX1 and PAX3 are on the concordant list but have no literature or Open Targets support tying them into this or any other coherent programme, so they were left out rather than forced in.
